hero.title: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham
hero.summary: Amrita’s School of Agricultural Sciences is based at Arasampalayam near Coimbatore. Its undergraduate agriculture programme uses the Amrita Entrance Examination – Life Sciences admission route, while the school also lists agronomy postgraduate and research study within a farm-oriented educational setting.

overview.heading: Agricultural science at Arasampalayam
paragraphs: Amrita offers the four-year agriculture degree through its School of Agricultural Sciences in Coimbatore. The school emphasises field-oriented learning and connects agricultural training with technology. Its course list also names postgraduate agronomy and doctoral agronomy, creating a subject pathway beyond the undergraduate degree without implying that every course shares the same accreditation scope.

The programme page provides eligibility, entrance and fee information, but several sections carry different years. The clearly labelled annual tuition table is for 2025-26, while hostel and mess information is labelled 2026-27. Applicants should use the dedicated AEEL 2026 page for the entrance route and request a single consolidated fee schedule for their own cohort.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: The dedicated AEEL 2026 page includes undergraduate agriculture among its entrance programmes. The programme page states that admission depends on a valid AEEL rank. Reconfirm the final counselling notice and subject eligibility for the intended intake. The dated AEEL 2026 handbook specifies the agriculture PCB requirement and online application through applyug.amrita.edu. Its tentative 9–10 May 2026 examination dates are historical, not a current application opening.
eligibility_points: The programme page’s main criteria allow PCMB/PCB/PCM with 60% aggregate and a 55% subject threshold.
Its FAQ narrows the wording to PCB; applicants with PCM should obtain clarification.
AEEL 2026 agriculture rule: 60% aggregate PCB and 55% in each subject, as stated in the handbook.

steps.title: Confirm the course
steps.text: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake.

steps.title: Request the intake notice
steps.text: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

documents: Original academic certificates are required at counselling under the programme FAQ; photocopies alone are not sufficient.
The programme FAQ asks the candidate and a parent/guardian to attend the counselling desk.

faqs.question: Where is Amrita’s agricultural school located?
faqs.answer: Its contact address is J. P. Nagar, Arasampalayam, near Coimbatore.

faqs.question: Which entrance route is stated for agriculture?
faqs.answer: Admission is based on a valid AEEL rank; the dedicated 2026 entrance page includes B.Sc. Agriculture.

faqs.question: Are the published tuition amounts dated?
faqs.answer: The explicit annual tuition table is labelled 2025-26: INR 2,25,000 scholarship and INR 3,00,000 non-scholarship.

faqs.question: Does Amrita list agronomy after the B.Sc.?
faqs.answer: The school lists M.Sc. Agriculture in Agronomy and Ph.D. Agronomy.

faqs.question: Does the checked ICAR row cover all Amrita agricultural courses?
faqs.answer: It explicitly prints B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for 20 June 2024 to 19 June 2029. Other courses need separate evidence.
